title: capnorchis scandens
intro: Capnorchis scandens, commonly known as the "hanging orchid," is a species of flowering plant in the orchid family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Capnorchis scandens include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce stress and anxiety, and alleviate symptoms of insomnia. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
